mapper.select:
SELECT favorite_data.favoriteId, favorite_data.resourceType, favorite_data.resourceId, favorite_data.publicId, favorite_data.channelCode, favorite_data.title, favorite_data.subtitle, favorite_data.description, favorite_data.coverUrl, favorite_data.avatarUrl, favorite_data.sceneImageUrl, favorite_data.gender, favorite_data.occupation, favorite_data.storyMode, favorite_data.followerCount, favorite_data.dialogueCount, favorite_data.authorName, favorite_data.authorAvatar, favorite_data.resourceUpdatedAt, favorite_data.favoritedAt FROM (
SELECT f.id AS favoriteId, f.resource_type AS resourceType, f.resource_id AS resourceId, rp.id AS publicId, rp.channel_code AS channelCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(rp.display_title, ''), r.role_name) AS title, COALESCE(NULLIF(rp.display_subtitle, ''), r.role_subtitle) AS subtitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(rp.intro_text, ''), r.greeting) AS description, COALESCE(NULLIF(rp.cover_image_url, ''), r.cover_url) AS coverUrl, r.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, NULL AS sceneImageUrl, r.gender AS gender, r.occupation AS occupation, NULL AS storyMode, NULL AS followerCount, NULL AS dialogueCount, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, r.updated_at AS resourceUpdatedAt, f.created_at AS favoritedAt FROM ts_user_favorite f INNER JOIN ts_role_info r ON r.id = f.resource_id INNER JOIN ts_role_public rp ON rp.id = ( SELECT rp2.id FROM ts_role_public rp2 WHERE rp2.role_id = r.id AND rp2.status = 'online' ORDER BY rp2.sort_order ASC, rp2.published_at DESC, rp2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{query.userId} AND f.resource_type = 'role' AND f.status = 1 AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status != 0)
AND ( r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.role_subtitle LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR rp.display_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
UNION ALL
SELECT f.id AS favoriteId, f.resource_type AS resourceType, f.resource_id AS resourceId, sp.id AS publicId, sp.channel_code AS channelCode, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.display_title, ''), s.title) AS title, sp.display_subtitle AS subtitle, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.intro_text, ''), s.story_intro) AS description, COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.cover_image_url, ''), s.cover_url) AS coverUrl, NULL AS avatarUrl, s.scene_image_url AS sceneImageUrl, NULL AS gender, NULL AS occupation, s.story_mode AS storyMode, COALESCE(st.follower_count, 0) AS followerCount, COALESCE(st.dialogue_count, 0) AS dialogueCount, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, s.updated_at AS resourceUpdatedAt, f.created_at AS favoritedAt FROM ts_user_favorite f INNER JOIN ts_story_info s ON s.id = f.resource_id INNER JOIN ts_story_public sp ON sp.id = ( SELECT sp2.id FROM ts_story_public sp2 WHERE sp2.story_id = s.id AND sp2.status = 'online' ORDER BY sp2.sort_order ASC, sp2.published_at DESC, sp2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN ts_story_stat st ON st.story_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE f.user_id = #{query.userId} AND f.resource_type = 'story' AND f.status = 1 AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status != 9)
AND ( s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR s.story_intro LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR sp.display_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
) favorite_data ORDER BY favorite_data.favoritedAt DESC, favorite_data.favoriteId DESC

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ts_role_info r INNER JOIN ts_role_public rp ON rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.status = 'online' WHERE r.id = #{resourceId} AND (r.status IS NULL OR r.status != 0)
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ts_story_info s INNER JOIN ts_story_public sp ON sp.story_id = s.id AND sp.status = 'online' WHERE s.id = #{resourceId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status != 9)

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ts_user_favorite ( user_id, resource_type, resource_id, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, 1, #{now}, #{now} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 1, created_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}
